kenya.body: Kenya confirmed on 6 October 2026, and notified WHO under the IHR, its first imported BVD case. The patient, a Kenyan national who fell ill in DRC, travelled by road via Beni to Kampala (2 October) and flew to Nairobi (3 October); isolated on arrival and confirmed positive, the patient died on 5 October. Twenty-eight contacts are listed (family members and health workers), and 23 passengers and 4 crew of the flight are being traced. No further confirmed case had been reported as of 11 October.
